title: Exploring the adoption of water quality trading as an alternative stormwater regulatory compliance strategy for land development projects: A case study for Roanoke, Virginia
abstract: Urban stormwater runoff is a significant source of nutrient pollution that is very costly to treat. Water quality trading (WQT) is a market-based strategy that can be used to lower the costs associated with meeting stormwater quality regulations. While many WQT programs have experienced low participation, Virginia's program has seen high participation due to the inclusion of land developers and other regulated stormwater dischargers. However, the extent to which WQT is used as a compliance option by regulated stormwater dischargers is not well understood, particularly when compared with the adoption of traditional compliance options. To address this knowledge gap, we collated a novel dataset comprising site characteristics and stormwater compliance methods for all development projects in the City of Roanoke, Virginia from December 2015 to March 2022. We analyzed this dataset to characterize the adoption of nutrient offset credits and other compliance methods being used, including best management practices (BMPs) and improved land covers associated with reduced nutrient export. Results show that credits are the preferred compliance option in Roanoke and were used as the only treatment compliance method for 59% of projects with treatment requirements. Projects using credits corresponded with a lower median disturbed area (1.36 acres) and lower median nutrient load reduction requirement (0.69 pounds of total phosphorus per year) compared with other compliance methods. Furthermore, we found that 58% of the projects that used credits achieved stormwater quantity compliance using methods other than implementing stormwater control devices. By mapping buyers and sellers of credits, we found that all credit sellers are downstream of the development projects. We discuss how this downstream trading could be a cause for concern, as part of a larger discussion of the advantages of tracking stormwater compliance methods, drawing on Roanoke as a case study.
abstract_zh: 城市雨水径流是营养物污染的重要来源，且处理成本非常高。水质交易（WQT）是一种基于市场的策略，可用于降低满足雨水水质法规的相关成本。尽管许多水质交易项目参与度较低，但弗吉尼亚州的项目因纳入了土地开发商及其他受监管的雨水排放者而参与度较高。然而，与传统合规方式的采用相比，受监管的雨水排放者在多大程度上将水质交易作为合规选项，目前尚不清楚。为填补这一知识空白，我们整理了一个新的数据集，涵盖了弗吉尼亚州罗阿诺克市2015年12月至2022年3月期间所有开发项目的场地特征和雨水合规方式。我们分析了该数据集，以刻画营养物抵消信用额以及其他合规方式的采用情况，其中包括与减少营养物输出相关的最佳管理实践（BMP）和改良土地覆盖。结果表明，信用额是罗阿诺克的首选合规选项，对于有处理要求的项目中，59%仅以此作为处理合规方式。与其他合规方式相比，使用信用额的项目对应的扰动面积中位数较低（1.36英亩），营养物负荷削减要求中位数也较低（每年0.69磅总磷）。此外，我们发现，在使用信用额的项目中，有58%是通过采用非雨水控制设施的其他方法实现雨水数量合规的。通过绘制信用额买卖双方的分布图，我们发现所有信用额卖方都位于开发项目的下游。我们讨论了这种下游交易为何可能令人担忧，并在更广泛地讨论追踪雨水合规方式的优势时，以罗阿诺克作为案例进行了探讨。

title: Targeting for nonpoint source pollution reduction: A synthesis of lessons learned, remaining challenges, and emerging opportunities
Opportunities and Challenges for Including Oyster-Mediate Denitrification in Nitrogen Management Plans
Treatment of Legacy Nitrogen as a Compliance Option to Meet Chesapeake Bay TMDL Requirements
Does Ecosystem Valuation Contribute to Ecosystem Decision-making? Evidence from Hydropower Licensing
Feasibility of Using Woodchip Bioreactors to Treat Legacy Nitrogen to Meet Chesapeake Bay Water Quality Goals
abstract: The United States Environmental Protection Agency has established aggressive nutrient reduction goals to achieve water quality objectives for the Chesapeake Bay estuary. Nitrogen (N) reduction goals are proving particularly difficult to meet with an additional 20.4 million kg of annual nitrogen reductions needed by 2025, and many of the easily achievable and low-cost N reductions have been realized. We assess the feasibility of employing woodchip denitrifying bioreactors to treat legacy N derived from spring discharge in the Mid-Atlantic region. We estimate that in excess of 6100 kg of soluble N is discharged daily from United States Geological Survey identified springs in four Mid-Atlantic states within the Chesapeake Bay watershed. Based on typical bioreactor removal efficiency (30–55%) and potentially treatable flows (<6000 m 3 /d), widespread adoption of bioreactors to treat legacy N from 231 springs could conservatively result in 420–770 kg N removed per day, while strategic adoption targeting 48 springs with N concentrations of at least 3 mg/L and flows of at least 500 m 3 /d could result in 322–590 kg N removed per day more cost-effectively and with far fewer installations. A cost analysis indicates bioreactors can be a cost-effective N removal strategy, generally removing N for less than $5/kg·y. Relative to other nonpoint source pollution control practices, bioreactors also offer the ability to remove larger quantities of N per installation and are more easily monitored to quantify N reductions.
abstract_zh: 美国环境保护署为实现切萨皮克湾河口的水质目标，制定了严格的营养物削减目标。氮（N）削减目标正变得尤为难以实现：到2025年，仍需每年额外削减2040万千克氮，而许多容易实现且成本低廉的氮削减措施已经落实。我们评估了利用木屑反硝化生物反应器处理中大西洋地区泉水排放所带来的遗留氮的可行性。我们估计，在切萨皮克湾流域内四个中大西洋州，美国地质调查局识别出的泉水每天排放的可溶性氮超过6100千克。基于典型的生物反应器去除效率（30%–55%）以及可处理的潜在流量（<6000 m³/d），若在231处泉水广泛采用生物反应器处理遗留氮，保守估计每天可去除420–770千克氮；而若针对48处氮浓度至少为3 mg/L、流量至少为500 m³/d的泉水进行战略性采用，则每天可去除322–590千克氮，且成本效益更高、安装数量也少得多。成本分析表明，生物反应器可以是具有成本效益的氮去除策略，通常每去除1千克氮的年成本低于5美元。相较于其他非点源污染控制措施，生物反应器还能够在每处设施中去除更大量的氮，并且更便于监测以量化氮的削减。

title: Oyster Fishery in Rappahannock River, Chesapeake Bay, USA, East coast
venue: Book chapter in Global Change in Marine Systems: Societal and Governing Responses
abstract: The oyster fishery in Virginia is on the rebound. After nearly 50 years of declining production, harvests from both grounds with naturally occurring Crassostrea virginica oysters that are publicly managed (public grounds) and grounds leased by private cultivators (private grounds) have been on the rise over the last decade. Landings from the public grounds were reported as being 11 times greater in 2013 to 2014 than ten years earlier; for the private grounds the increase was nearly 22 times greater. The dramatic upswing is a result of state-funded restoration programs on the public grounds and technological advances in aquaculture which primarily benefit private growers. One area that has been a focus of state restoration efforts is the public oyster grounds in the mouth of the Rappahannock. The Rappahannock River is one of five major tributaries flowing into the Chesapeake Bay. The oyster grounds of the Chesapeake Bay and its tributaries were a significant source of oysters for the U.S. market from the early nineteenth century. The long-term decline began with the appearance in the early 1960s of the parasites known as MSX ( Haplosporidium nelsoni ) and Dermo ( Perkinsus marinus ). Pollution, sedimentation and other environmental problems further contributed to this deterioration. The I-ADApT tool is used to present the problems faced in the fishery over the last 50 years, the responses that have led to a revival of the fishery only in recent years and newly emerging challenges. First, background information about the bay and the fishery establish the context. The evolution of the governance structure since 1902 is then summarized. Stressors, both environmental and market forces, leading to the decline in the last half-century are described. The case study appraising the responses in one part of the fishery, the mouth of the Rappahannock River, is then presented.
abstract_zh: 弗吉尼亚州的牡蛎渔业正在复苏。经历了近50年的产量下降之后，过去十年间，来自天然生长的弗吉尼亚巨牡蛎（Crassostrea virginica）的采捕量——包括由公共管理的公共水域（public grounds）以及由私人养殖者租用的私有水域（private grounds）——均有所上升。据报告，公共水域的捕获量在2013至2014年间是十年前的11倍；而私有水域的增幅接近22倍。这一显著的回升，得益于州政府资助的公共水域恢复计划，以及主要惠及私人养殖者的水产养殖技术进步。州政府恢复工作的重点之一，是拉帕汉诺克河口（Rappahannock River mouth）的公共牡蛎水域。拉帕汉诺克河是流入切萨皮克湾的五条主要支流之一。自19世纪初以来，切萨皮克湾及其支流的牡蛎水域一直是美国市场牡蛎的重要来源。长期衰退始于20世纪60年代初，当时出现了被称为MSX（Haplosporidium nelsoni）和Dermo（Perkinsus marinus）的寄生虫。污染、泥沙淤积以及其他环境问题进一步加剧了这一恶化。I-ADApT工具被用于呈现过去50年间渔业所面临的问题、仅在近年才促使渔业复苏的应对措施，以及新出现的挑战。首先，关于海湾和渔业的背景信息为研究奠定了语境。随后，我们总结了自1902年以来治理结构的演变。接着，我们描述了过去半个世纪导致衰退的压力因素，包括环境因素和市场力量。最后，我们呈现了对渔业一个部分（即拉帕汉诺克河口）应对措施的案例研究评估。

title: The Role of In lieu Fee Programs in Wetland/Stream Mitigation Credit Trading: Illustrations from Virginia and Georgia
Can Water Quality Trading Fix the Agricultural Nonpoint Source Problem?
abstract: Policy analysts and government agencies promote a particular form of what they term water quality trading as a means to address the most vexing obstacle to meeting water quality standards: reducing nutrient pollutants from agricultural nonpoint sources. However, agricultural nonpoint sources’ participation in water quality trading programs will only make limited contributions to lowering overall pollutant loads. We argue that economists need to more clearly articulate the limitations of current and proposed water quality trading programs as a water quality management strategy. A new generation of market-like incentive policies will be necessary to make significant progress in reducing agricultural nonpoint source loads.
abstract_zh: 政策分析人士与政府机构推崇一种特定形式的水质交易，将其视为应对达到水质标准所面临的最棘手障碍的手段：减少农业非点源的营养物污染物。然而，农业非点源参与水质交易项目，只能对降低总体污染物负荷做出有限的贡献。我们认为，经济学家需要更清晰地阐明当前及拟议中的水质交易项目作为水质管理策略的局限性。要在减少农业非点源负荷方面取得实质性进展，必须推行新一代类市场激励政策。

Market-like Water Quality Trading: Why It Matters, and How to Make it Happen
venue: Book chapter in Aquanomics: Water Markets and the Environment
abstract: This chapter shows that water quality trading, as usually practiced, is simply an extension of Clean Water Act (CWA) command and control regulation. Understanding this argument requires an explanation of National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) permits and permitting process. It shows that it is misleading to call the outcome of these programs "trading" because there is no intent to allow increases in discharges from one source to be offset by equivalent reductions from other sources. The chapter describes basic characteristics of market-like program design. It refers to allowance-focused system as a Cap and Allowance Market and describes advantages of such a system as compared to the NPDES-focused water quality management program. The chapter describes some of practical implementation challenges and also suggests opportunities to facilitate implementation of market-like programs for water quality management. It concludes with suggestions for ways to add market-like properties to water quality management within existing statutory and regulatory confines of the CWA.
abstract_zh: 本章指出，通常实践中的水质交易，实质上只是《清洁水法》（CWA）命令—控制型监管的延伸。要理解这一论点，需要先解释国家污染物排放消除系统（NPDES）许可证及其许可程序。本章表明，将这些项目的结果称为“交易”具有误导性，因为其意图并非允许一个排放源的排放增加，由其他排放源的等量减排所抵消。本章阐述了类市场项目设计的基本特征。它将以配额为核心的体系称为“总量与配额市场”（Cap and Allowance Market），并描述了这一体系相较于以NPDES为核心的水质管理计划的优势。本章还阐述了一些实际执行中的挑战，并提出了促进类市场水质管理项目实施的机会。最后，本章提出了在《清洁水法》现行法定与监管框架内，为水质管理增添类市场特征的若干建议。

Rhetoric and Reality of Water Quality Trading and the Potential for Market-like Reform
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: Stephenson, Kurt and Leonard Shabman, 2011. Rhetoric and Reality of Water Quality Trading and the Potential for Market-Like Reform. Journal of the American Water Resources Association (JAWRA) 47(1):15-28. DOI: 10.1111/j.1752-1688.2010.00492.x Abstract: Many public interest groups, government agencies, and professional economists argue that current approaches to water quality trading are a cost-effective, politically practical innovation for achieving water quality standards, in part by addressing one of the most difficult water quality improvement challenges – limiting the discharge from nonpoint sources. A critical analysis shows that these claims for current water quality trading programs are often unrealized. This rhetoric, without adherence to principles of market-like reform, can undermine the support of regulated parties for meaningful water quality policy reform, contribute to missed opportunities to implement cost-effective programs, and postpone successfully meeting the challenge of limiting nonpoint source discharges. A better understanding and application of market-like principles can result in an improved design of trading as well as general water quality management programs.
abstract_zh: Stephenson, Kurt 与 Leonard Shabman，2011年。《水质交易的修辞与现实及类市场改革的潜力》。《美国水资源协会杂志》（JAWRA）47(1):15-28。DOI: 10.1111/j.1752-1688.2010.00492.x。摘要：许多公共利益团体、政府机构和专业经济学家认为，当前的水质交易方法是实现水质标准的一种具有成本效益且政治上可行的创新，部分原因在于其解决了最困难的水质改善挑战之一——限制非点源排放。批判性分析表明，这些关于当前水质交易项目的主张往往未能实现。这种修辞若缺乏对类市场改革原则的遵循，可能会削弱受监管方对有意义的水质政策改革的支持，导致错失实施具有成本效益项目的机会，并推迟成功应对限制非点源排放的挑战。更好地理解和应用类市场原则，能够改进交易的设计以及总体的水质管理项目。

title: The Purpose and Goal for CADRe
An Evaluation of Nutrient Nonpoint Offset Trading in Virginia: A Role for Agricultural Nonpoint Sources?
abstract: Many advocates of water quality trading in the United States frequently assume that agricultural nonpoint sources will be the primary trading partner for regulated point sources. Virginia requires regulated point sources to offset new nutrient discharges. Nutrient offsets generated by agricultural nonpoint source reductions are compared against urban nonpoint source and nutrient assimilation offsets. Evidence suggests that agricultural nonpoint source offsets may not be a technically feasible or particularly cost effective compliance option for regulated point sources.
abstract_zh: 美国许多水质交易的倡导者经常假定，农业非点源将是受监管点源的主要交易伙伴。弗吉尼亚州要求受监管的点源抵消新增的营养物排放。我们将农业非点源减排产生的营养物抵消量，与城市非点源及营养物同化抵消量进行了比较。证据表明，对于受监管的点源而言，农业非点源抵消可能在技术上不可行，或在成本效益上并不特别突出，因而不是一个特别合适的合规选项。

title: Effectiveness of Residential Water-Use Restrictions under Varying Levels of Municipal Effort
abstract: Given the current constraints in expanding public water capacity, water supply managers will increasingly be required to find ways to reduce demand during temporary water shortages. Consequently, water supply managers need sound estimates for the effectiveness of water reduction programs. This study expands the water demand literature by identifying the influence that enforcement and informational efforts have on the two most common forms of nonprice water-use restrictions. Residential water-use reductions increased with progressively higher levels of information and enforcement efforts, ranging from 0% to 7% for voluntary and 4% to 22% for mandatory restrictions. (JEL Q25)
abstract_zh: 鉴于当前扩大公共供水能力所面临的制约，供水管理者将越来越需要寻找在临时性缺水期间减少需求的方法。因此，供水管理者需要对节水计划有效性的可靠估计。本研究通过识别执法与信息宣传努力对两种最常见的非价格用水限制形式的影响，拓展了水需求文献。随着信息宣传和执法努力水平的逐步提高，居民用水量减少幅度增加：自愿限制下减少0%至7%，强制限制下减少4%至22%。（JEL Q25）

title: Farm Returns to Carbon Credit Creation with Intensive Rotational Grazing
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Intensive rotational grazing systems may produce multiple environmental services, including reduction of the emissions of greenhouse gases (GHG). This study investigates potential GHG emission reduction credits obtained by converting Virginia cow-calf and dairy farm operations from conventional grazing operations to rotational grazing. The quantity and value of the change in GHG emissions are estimated using new US Department of Energy guidelines. Credits are estimated under three boundary conditions and two accounting metrics. Results suggest conversion to rotational grazing can generate GHG reduction credits, but the financial benefits farms receive from emissions reductions are modest. The amount of credits received is sensitive to choice of accounting metric and boundary definition.
abstract_zh: 集约化轮牧系统可能带来多种环境服务，包括减少温室气体（GHG）排放。本研究考察了将弗吉尼亚州的母牛—小牛（cow-calf）和奶牛养殖场，从传统放牧方式转换为轮牧所可能获得的温室气体减排信用额。温室气体排放变化的数量和价值，采用美国能源部的新指南进行估算。在三种边界条件和两种核算指标下估计了信用额。结果表明，转向轮牧能够产生温室气体减排信用额，但农场从排放减少中获得的经济效益较为有限。信用额的数量对核算指标和边界定义的选择较为敏感。

title: Approaches to TMDL Planning and Implementation and Policy Tools for Implementation to Achieve Water Quality Standards
venue: CAB Reviews: Perspectives in Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Nutrition and Natural Resources
abstract: This review is based primarily on information gathered in the TMDL Knowledgebase Clearinghouse developed by the Center for Total Maximum Daily Load (TMDL) and Watershed Studies at Virginia Tech. The TMDL programme has received renewed attention since the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) published revised guidelines in 1991. Under the TMDL programme, pollutant-specific TMDLs are developed for impaired waters. A TMDL specifies the pollutant load reductions needed to achieve water quality standards. The magnitude and distribution of the load reductions among pollution sources can have implications for watershed stakeholders. Implementing the TMDL load reductions is the responsibility of the individual US states. Adaptive implementation occurs when limited corrective actions designed to improve water quality are implemented using available information and data; and as information and data availability improve implementation adjustments are made, i.e. 'learn while doing'. While several policy tools are available to ensure that corrective actions are implemented, economic incentives are most often used, particularly for non-point source pollution sources. Typically, successful TMDL implementation depends on careful planning and stakeholder engagement. However, meaningful stakeholder engagement requires that stakeholders be empowered to make decisions about outcomes relevant to their goals, which may be problematic given the narrow way the TMDL process is currently enacted. Planning using watershed-scale models to assess plausible load reduction scenarios is most likely to produce credible TMDL pollutant load estimates. Models should be coupled with adaptive implementation so that pollutant load estimates can be revised as better information becomes available. TMDL implementation plans should consider both barriers to and opportunities for implementation.
abstract_zh: 本综述主要基于弗吉尼亚理工大学总最大日负荷（TMDL）与流域研究中心所建立的TMDL知识库信息交换所（TMDL Knowledgebase Clearinghouse）收集的信息。自美国环境保护署（EPA）于1991年发布修订指南以来，TMDL计划重新受到关注。在TMDL计划下，针对受损水体制定特定污染物的TMDL。TMDL规定了为达到水质标准所需削减的污染物负荷。各污染源之间的负荷削减幅度和分配，可能对流域利益相关方产生影响。落实TMDL负荷削减的责任由各州承担。适应性实施是指，在利用现有信息和数据实施有限的纠正行动以改善水质的同时，随着信息和数据的可获得性提高，相应地调整实施方案，即“边做边学”。虽然有若干政策工具可以确保纠正行动得以落实，但经济激励手段最常被使用，尤其是针对非点源污染源。通常，TMDL的成功实施取决于审慎的规划和利益相关方的参与。然而，有意义的利益相关方参与要求其有权就与其目标相关的结果做出决定，而鉴于目前TMDL程序的狭隘立法方式，这一点可能存在问题。利用流域尺度模型评估可信的负荷削减情景进行规划，最有可能产生可信的TMDL污染物负荷估计。模型应与适应性实施相结合，使得随着更好信息的出现，污染物负荷估计可以得到修正。TMDL实施方案应同时考虑实施的障碍与机遇。

title: Trading as a Water Quality Management Tool: Prospects for a Market Alternative
venue: Book chapter in Sustainable Watershed Management in Theory and Practice
abstract: The paper reviews current experience with water quality trading programs and evaluates trading's potential as a future water quality management tool. The relative virtues of cap and trade (CAT) versus regulatory offset programs are discussed, as are administrative and technical barriers to trading. Several existing trade programs are discussed in detail. The article places particular emphasis on the relationship between water quality trading and watershed-based regulatory initiatives such as the total maximum daily load program.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了水质交易项目的现有经验，并评估了交易作为未来水质管理工具的潜力。文章讨论了总量控制与交易（CAT）与监管抵消项目的相对优势，以及交易面临的行政和技术障碍。文章详细讨论了若干现有的交易项目。文章特别强调了水质交易与基于流域的监管举措（如总最大日负荷计划）之间的关系。

Comparisons of the Educational Value of Distance versus Traditional Classroom Instruction in Introductory Agricultural Economics
abstract: As many universities are promoting distance courses, the comparative advantages and disadvantages over conventional classroom delivery are being debated. Student attitudes and test performance in an introductory microeconomics course are compared across the two different course delivery formats. Results show that students with average or below-average college aptitude test scores perform more poorly in the distance class.
abstract_zh: 随着许多大学大力推广远程课程，远程教学与传统课堂授课相比的优劣势正引发争论。本研究比较了两种不同授课形式下，学生在入门微观经济学课程中的态度与考试表现。结果表明，大学能力倾向测试成绩处于中等或中等以下的学生，在远程课程中表现较差。

title: Trading Programs for Environmental Management: Reflections on the Air and Water Experiences
abstract: Emission and effluent trading programs are increasingly being advocated for the nation's air and water quality programs. However, important distinctions must be drawn between credit and allowance trading, based on how much decision-making authority is transferred from regulators to dischargers. Credit trading programs are extensions of command-and-control regulation. Allowance trading programs, like markets, decentralize decisions on the means to control discharges and the location of that control. A review of existing trading programs finds allowance trading programs stimulate more aggressive pollution prevention behavior and result in lower compliance costs than credit trading.
abstract_zh: 排放与排污权交易项目正日益被倡导用于国家的空气和水质计划。然而，必须区分信用额交易与配额交易，区别在于决策权从监管者向排放者转移的程度。信用额交易项目是命令—控制型监管的延伸。配额交易项目则与市场类似，将控制排放的方式及控制地点的决策进行了分散化。对现有交易项目的回顾发现，配额交易项目能够激励更积极的污染预防行为，并比信用额交易带来更低的合规成本。

title: Assessments of the Educational Value of Web-Based Instructional Tools in Introductory Agricultural Economics
abstract: A web site was designed and introduced to an introductory agricultural microeconomics course. The web site provided students with supplemental reviews, practice problems, self-tests, and a simulation exercise. A variety of quantitative assessments were conducted to determine whether the web site influenced student learning, perceptions, and motivation. Results indicate the web site provided small to modest educational benefits.
abstract_zh: 我们为一门农业微观经济学入门课程设计并引入了一个网站。该网站为学生提供补充性的复习材料、练习题、自测题以及模拟练习。我们开展了多项定量评估，以确定该网站是否影响了学生的学习、认知和学习动机。结果表明，该网站带来了微小至中等程度的教育益处。

title: Environmental Valuation and Its Economic Critics
venue: Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management
abstract: In the last few decades economists have devoted significant professional attention to developing and applying methods to place monetary values on environmental services. This paper summarizes the criticisms from within the economics profession of the environmental valuation research program. Generally, the critics question whether meaningful benefit estimates can be made for environmental services and, if made, whether the estimates are acceptable guides to making environmental policy. We conclude by noting that the debate over the “value of valuation” in water resources will not subside, because this debate is part of a wider intellectual dialogue regarding the role of analysts and quantification in the making of public policy.
abstract_zh: 在过去几十年中，经济学家投入了大量专业精力，致力于开发和应用为环境服务赋予货币价值的方法。本文总结了经济学界内部对环境估值研究计划的批评。总体而言，批评者质疑能否对环境服务做出有意义的效益估计，以及即使能够做出此类估计，这些估计是否可以作为环境政策制定的可接受指南。最后，我们指出，关于水资源领域“估值的价值”的争论不会平息，因为这场争论是关于分析人员与量化在公共政策制定中所扮演角色的更广泛学术对话的一部分。

Cost Implications in Achieving Alternative Water Quality Targets
abstract: Excessive nutrient loading poses significant water quality problems in many water bodies across the country. An important question that must be addressed when nutrient reduction policies are devised is where nutrient reduction targets will be applied within the watershed. This paper examines the cost implications of establishing three possible nutrient reduction targets in different locations along the Fox‐Wolf River basin in northeast Wisconsin. A linear programming model calculates the total cost of achieving a 50% phosphorus load reduction target established in various locations throughout the basin. Two strategies establish phosphorus reduction targets for each of the 41 subwatersheds, and the third approach establishes a single 50% target reduction at Green Bay for the entire watershed. The results indicate that achieving target phosphorus reductions at the subwatershed level is over 4 times more expensive than achieving the same percentage phosphorus reduction for the watershed as a whole.
abstract_zh: 过量的营养物负荷对全国众多水体造成了严重的水质问题。在制定营养物削减政策时，一个重要问题是：营养物削减目标应当在流域内的哪些位置实施。本文考察了在威斯康星州东北部Fox-Wolf河流域的三个不同位置设定三种可能的营养物削减目标所带来的成本影响。一个线性规划模型用于计算在流域各处设定的、实现50%磷负荷削减目标的总成本。两种策略为41个子流域分别设定磷削减目标，第三种方法则为整个流域在绿湾（Green Bay）设定单一的50%削减目标。结果表明，在子流域层面实现磷削减目标的成本，是实现整个流域同等百分比磷削减成本的4倍以上。

title: Environmental Policy Reform: A Taxonomy of Economists' Perspectives
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: As the environmental policy recommendations of economists become more acceptable, differences in the professional understanding of, and support for, different policy forms are becoming more apparent. These different approaches to environmental policy and research are described around a taxonomy of four perspectives: “rational analysts,” “cost analysts,” “market managers,” and “free market environmentalists.” These perspectives are compared and contrasted. Recognition of these differences can result in a better appreciation of the different research agendas of economists and can improve clarity in teaching and policy advising.
abstract_zh: 随着经济学家的环境政策建议日益为人接受，不同政策形式在专业理解及支持程度上的差异也日益明显。本文围绕四种视角的分类体系，描述了这些不同的环境政策与研究途径：“理性分析者”（rational analysts）、“成本分析者”（cost analysts）、“市场管理者”（market managers）以及“自由市场环保主义者”（free market environmentalists）。文章对这些视角进行了比较和对照。认识到这些差异，有助于更好地理解经济学家们不同的研究议程，并能提高教学和政策咨询的清晰度。
